feature_plan.rationale: All signals exploited: direct numerics, Sex/Embarked one-hot, title/deck/ticket_prefix extracted from high-cardinality strings, per-fold target aggregates on top-3 predictors (Sex, Pclass, Embarked, Sex×Pclass) and ticket group size. Interactions cover the three prioritized pairs plus family size. No lag features (non-time-series). All target-derived aggregates fit per fold; ticket_prefix target-encoding per fold. ~22 total features on 891 rows (ratio 0.025) — well below overfit threshold.

derived_features_note.title: Extracted from Name column using regex on salutation (Mr/Mrs/Miss/Master/Rare); fold-safe (no target information)
derived_features_note.deck: First character of Cabin string; missing assigned separate 'Unknown' category
derived_features_note.has_cabin: Binary flag: 1 if Cabin is non-null, 0 otherwise — captures the informative missingness pattern
derived_features_note.ticket_prefix: Alphabetic prefix of Ticket string; numeric-only tickets get prefix 'NUM'
derived_features_note.ticket_group_size: Count of passengers per Ticket value computed on fold-train only

representation_strategy.rationale: i.i.d. tabular data confirmed by guardian (stratified_kfold); no time series, no image sidecars, no free-text columns (text_like_columns=[]) — standard feature engineering with categorical extraction from Name/Cabin/Ticket is sufficient.
representation_strategy.programmer_instructions: Extract title from Name regex, deck letter from Cabin, ticket prefix+group size from Ticket; build Sex×Pclass, Sex×Age, Pclass×Fare interactions and family_size; all target-derived aggregates strictly per fold; impute Age by title-group median from fold-train.

metric_decision.rationale: spec_parse.json.evaluation_metric = 'accuracy' explicitly; binary classification task with class_label output format.

modeling_hints.reasoning_prefer_regularized: n_train=891, total_features~22, ratio=0.025 — well below 0.10 threshold; regularized models not forced by data size
modeling_hints.apply_log1p_reason: Binary classification target; data_profile.target_distribution.recommend_log_transform=false; log transform not applicable
priority_notes: Sex is the dominant predictor (target rate 74.2% female vs 18.9% male) — models must capture this signal and its interactions with Pclass and Age
Age (19.9%) and Cabin (77.1%) have substantial missingness — use CatBoost/HistGBT for native NaN handling; Age imputation by title group adds signal
Moderate class imbalance (38.4% positive) — stratified folds already set by guardian; monitor class-weight sensitivity in linear models

model_family_recommendation.rationale: n_rows=891 (adequate for GBDT), 2 high-cardinality categoricals (Ticket cardinality 681, Cabin 147), Age+Cabin missingness >5% — GBDT with native NaN handling is preferred; linear second for diversity.

completeness_constraints.submission_frame_expansion: prediction frame has 418 rows (data/test.csv); sample submission (data/gender_submission.csv) also has 418 rows — direct 1:1 mapping; no cross-join expansion needed

advisory_issues: Cabin has 77.1% missing — deck extraction will have low coverage; has_cabin binary flag compensates by capturing the informative missingness pattern
